# EZVIZ
> EZVIZ provides smart home security devices, cloud services, mobile apps, and support resources for cameras, doorbells, locks, and related products.

EZVIZ offers consumer smart home products and services centered on video security, home access, automation, and cloud-connected device management. Its website includes product catalogs, app information, support resources, firmware and manual downloads, and regional service information.

## Main Site
- [Home](https://www.ezvizlife.com/): Main entry point for EZVIZ smart home products, services, and brand information.
- [Products](https://www.ezvizlife.com/product): Browse EZVIZ cameras, doorbells, locks, sensors, and smart home devices.
- [Support](https://www.ezvizlife.com/support): Access product help, manuals, downloads, FAQs, and troubleshooting resources.
- [EZVIZ App](https://www.ezvizlife.com/ezviz-app): Overview of the EZVIZ mobile app for device management and monitoring.
- [CloudPlay](https://www.ezvizlife.com/service/cloudplay): Learn about EZVIZ cloud video storage and subscription features.
- [Where to Buy](https://www.ezvizlife.com/where-to-buy): Find authorized retailers and purchase channels for EZVIZ products.

## Product Categories
- [Security Cameras](https://www.ezvizlife.com/product/security-camera): Explore indoor and outdoor smart security camera models.
- [Video Doorbells](https://www.ezvizlife.com/product/video-doorbell): View smart doorbell products with video, audio, and visitor alerts.
- [Smart Locks](https://www.ezvizlife.com/product/smart-lock): Browse connected lock products for home entry control.
- [Alarm Sensors](https://www.ezvizlife.com/product/alarm-sensor): Discover sensors and alarm accessories for home monitoring.
- [Robot Vacuum](https://www.ezvizlife.com/product/robot-vacuum): Review EZVIZ robotic cleaning devices and related features.
- [Accessories](https://www.ezvizlife.com/product/accessory): Find mounts, storage, power, and other device accessories.

## Services
- [CloudPlay](https://www.ezvizlife.com/service/cloudplay): Cloud recording service for storing and reviewing security footage.
- [EZVIZ App](https://www.ezvizlife.com/ezviz-app): Mobile application for live view, playback, alerts, and device settings.
- [EZVIZ Studio](https://www.ezvizlife.com/ezviz-studio): Desktop software for viewing and managing EZVIZ devices.
- [Works with Google Assistant](https://www.ezvizlife.com/service/google-assistant): Information on Google Assistant integration for EZVIZ devices.
- [Works with Amazon Alexa](https://www.ezvizlife.com/service/alexa): Information on Alexa voice control and smart home compatibility.
- [Works with IFTTT](https://www.ezvizlife.com/service/ifttt): Automation integration details for connecting EZVIZ with IFTTT workflows.
